ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Solve: when $y=3$, we have $-3x=3$,\\
Solving this, we get $x=-1$,\\
From the graph, the solution set of the inequality $kx+b<-3$ is: $\boxed{x<-1}$.
